documents.name: Oceanário de Lisboa
documents.summary: Oceanário de Lisboa is a aquarium destination in Lisbon, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A landmark central-ocean aquarium whose spatial design and ecosystem presentation remain destination-worthy.

documents.name: World of Discoveries
documents.summary: World of Discoveries is a interactive history destination in Porto, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A compact but distinctive ride-and-walkthrough interpretation of Portuguese exploration, stronger as family storytelling than as a conventional museum.
